Title: Condominium declaration review
Summary: Build a cited issue matrix from a declaration and amendments.
RolePerspective: Florida condominium counsel conducting due diligence for [buyer or lender]
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [attach declaration], [amendments], [property/transaction context], [review date].
TASK: Identify provisions on unit boundaries, common elements, limited common elements, maintenance, insurance, leasing, voting, amendment, and termination. Reconcile conflicting amendments.
OUTPUT: An issue matrix with document/page, operative language, practical effect, question for counsel, and priority. Quote only short necessary excerpts. Identify missing exhibits and any provision requiring a current Chapter 718 check.

Title: Condominium board vote analysis
Summary: Map quorum, voting and notice questions to governing sources.
RolePerspective: Florida condominium association counsel advising the board
PromptBody:
CONTEXT: [meeting facts], [governing documents], [dates], [minutes and notices].
TASK: Analyze whether the proposed Florida condominium board action followed applicable notice, quorum, and voting requirements. Start with a dated chronology; distinguish what the documents say from current statutory requirements.
OUTPUT: Issue / governing source / record fact / analysis / missing evidence / practical correction. Identify any issue that requires counsel to inspect the actual meeting record.

Title: Condominium records request triage
Summary: Organize a records demand and the response steps.
RolePerspective: Florida condominium association counsel preparing an official-records response
PromptBody:
INPUT: [owner request], [receipt date and method], [association record inventory], [prior response].
TASK: Sort each item requested into available, needs search, potentially restricted, and unclear. Check the applicable Florida condominium official-records rules as of [date]; do not assume every requested item is disclosable.
OUTPUT: A response decision tree, deadline calendar with stated assumptions, document collection checklist, and a concise draft acknowledgement for counsel review.

Title: Structural reserve decision memo
Summary: Frame board decisions from inspection and reserve records.
RolePerspective: Florida condominium association counsel preparing a board decision memo
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [building age and location], [inspection reports], [reserve study], [budget], [meeting materials].
TASK: Prepare a Florida condominium board memo on the documented repair and reserve decisions. Verify which current milestone-inspection and structural-integrity-reserve requirements apply before stating deadlines or funding duties.
OUTPUT: Executive decision list, evidence table, obligations to confirm, funding options stated as scenarios, and questions for the engineer and manager. Do not make engineering conclusions.

Title: Association insurance allocation
Summary: Compare declaration, policy, and statutory responsibility.
RolePerspective: Florida condominium counsel evaluating a documented casualty allocation
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [declaration], [insurance policy excerpts], [damage facts], [loss date].
TASK: Compare the allocation of insurance, repair, deductible, and owner responsibilities under the supplied documents and applicable Florida condominium law. Avoid deciding coverage without the actual policy and claim facts.
OUTPUT: A three-column comparison of source language, affected property, and responsibility; then list conflicts, carrier questions, and proposed next steps.

Title: Condominium lease restriction review
Summary: Assess restrictions and approval mechanics in context.
RolePerspective: Florida condominium counsel for [association or unit owner]
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [declaration/bylaws/rules], [amendments], [proposed lease], [relevant unit history].
TASK: Identify operative Florida condominium lease restrictions, approval procedures, transfer fees, duration limits, and amendment or grandfathering issues. Trace each restriction to its source and effective date.
OUTPUT: Clause-by-clause table, open factual questions, and a short proposed client explanation. Flag any enforceability question for current authority research.

Title: HOA covenant enforcement file
Summary: Build an evenhanded enforcement record review.
RolePerspective: Florida HOA counsel evaluating covenant enforcement
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [recorded covenants], [rules], [alleged violation], [photos/letters], [comparable enforcement history].
TASK: Evaluate the documented basis for a Florida HOA covenant enforcement decision, including notice, cure, hearing, and consistency issues where applicable. Keep allegations separate from proven facts.
OUTPUT: Evidence matrix, timeline, process checklist, weaknesses in the file, and a neutral notice outline for attorney review.

Title: HOA election process checklist
Summary: Organize election steps against actual documents.
RolePerspective: Florida HOA counsel preparing an election checklist
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [governing documents], [election date], [notices], [nomination and ballot procedures].
TASK: Build a Florida HOA election checklist tailored to the supplied documents and current applicable law. Distinguish statutory requirements from document-specific requirements; do not assume condominium election rules apply.
OUTPUT: Date-driven checklist with source for each step, owner, required proof, and unresolved questions.

Title: Board recall chronology
Summary: Test service, voting, and meeting events.
RolePerspective: Florida association counsel assessing a proposed director recall
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [association type], [petition or ballots], [service evidence], [owner roster], [board meeting notice/minutes].
TASK: Construct a neutral chronology of a Florida association director recall. Identify disputed signatures, voting entitlements, service, timing, and replacement issues without assuming recall validity.
OUTPUT: Dated chronology, issue matrix with controlling source to verify, missing evidence, and immediate procedural decisions for counsel.

Title: Purchase agreement risk scan
Summary: Identify negotiated risk and unfilled business terms.
RolePerspective: Florida real-estate counsel for [buyer or seller]
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [purchase agreement], [exhibits], [deal summary], [client priorities].
TASK: Review diligence, title, survey, financing, representations, casualty, default, closing deliverables, and survival. Preserve the agreement's defined terms.
OUTPUT: Ranked risk matrix with clause reference, present wording, business impact, proposed revision, and negotiation priority. List missing exhibits and dates separately.

Title: Closing obligation tracker
Summary: Turn transaction documents into an actionable closing list.
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [signed agreement], [amendments], [title commitment], [lender checklist], [target closing date].
TASK: Extract each condition, notice, deliverable, funding step, and deadline. Reconcile amendments and distinguish explicit dates from calculated dates.
OUTPUT: Tracker columns: obligation, responsible party, source/page, trigger, due date or formula, status, and open question. Do not silently calculate a disputed deadline.

Title: Estoppel certificate reconciliation
Summary: Compare estoppel answers to contract and records.
RolePerspective: Florida real-estate closing counsel reconciling association documents
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [association estoppel], [purchase contract], [ledger], [governing documents], [closing date].
TASK: Reconcile amounts, pending assessments, violations, approval requirements, transfer fees, and estoppel validity as shown in the supplied records. Verify any Florida statutory effect before drawing a legal conclusion.
OUTPUT: Discrepancy table with quoted source location, closing consequence, party to contact, and proposed resolution.

Title: Commercial lease issue list
Summary: Review a Florida commercial lease from one party’s position.
RolePerspective: Florida commercial leasing counsel for [landlord or tenant]
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [lease], [term sheet], [property details], [negotiation priorities].
TASK: Compare economics, use, repairs, CAM, insurance, assignment, default, remedies, casualty, condemnation, options, and surrender against the term sheet.
OUTPUT: Clause reference, issue, practical risk, suggested revision, priority, and business input needed. Do not treat residential tenancy statutes as automatically applicable.

Title: Residential lease compliance inventory
Summary: Spot missing facts and provisions for Florida housing.
RolePerspective: Florida residential leasing counsel for [landlord or tenant]
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [residential lease and addenda], [property location], [building age], [deposit arrangement], [proposed commencement].
TASK: Review a Florida residential lease for issues requiring current state or applicable federal law checks, including disclosures, deposits, access, fees, termination, and remedies. Do not assert that a disclosure applies without the relevant property facts.
OUTPUT: Ranked checklist with lease citation, authority to verify, proposed fix, and missing fact.

Title: Land use entitlement roadmap
Summary: Map approvals for a proposed Florida project.
RolePerspective: Florida land-use counsel advising the project team
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [parcel and jurisdiction], [proposed use], [zoning map/code], [prior approvals], [development schedule].
TASK: Identify apparent land use approval paths and threshold questions, distinguishing adopted text from staff practice or assumptions. Check the relevant local government sources and current Florida law if research is available.
OUTPUT: Permit/approval decision tree, likely sequence, dependencies, public-hearing points, and questions for planning staff. Do not guarantee entitlement.

Title: Title commitment exceptions
Summary: Turn Schedule B into a buyer action list.
RolePerspective: Florida buyer-side title counsel preparing a curative list
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [current title commitment], [recorded exception instruments], [contract], [buyer intended use].
TASK: Pair each Schedule B requirement and exception with its underlying instrument. Identify monetary liens, access or use restrictions, survey-dependent matters, and items needing insurer confirmation.
OUTPUT: Item number, recorded source, practical effect, curative request, responsible party, and priority. Do not conclude an exception is harmless without the instrument.

Title: Survey and title reconciliation
Summary: Identify gaps between survey callouts and recorded rights.
RolePerspective: Florida title counsel coordinating questions with a licensed surveyor
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [survey], [legal description], [title commitment], [recorded easements].
TASK: Reconcile parcel description, access, visible improvements, encroachments, easement locations, and survey notes. Identify issues requiring surveyor clarification or title insurer underwriting.
OUTPUT: Map-reference or survey-note / recorded-document / possible effect / person to resolve table. Do not give a surveyor's boundary opinion.

Title: Legal description comparison
Summary: Find textual conflicts in property descriptions.
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [deed description], [contract exhibit], [survey description], [prior recorded instrument].
TASK: Extract the point of beginning, calls, bearings, distances, parcel identifiers, exceptions, and exhibit references from each description. Compare exact wording and flag missing pages or inconsistent calls.
OUTPUT: Side-by-side difference table and questions for title counsel or surveyor. Do not infer that descriptions convey the same land from approximate wording alone.

Title: Civil complaint issue map
Summary: Evaluate allegations and supporting documents.
RolePerspective: Florida civil litigator assessing an initial pleading
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [Florida civil complaint], [key contract/record documents], [client chronology], [service date].
TASK: Map each count, requested relief, factual allegation, and attached exhibit. Identify facial gaps, inconsistencies, potential response issues, and facts to investigate under current Florida procedure.
OUTPUT: Claim / alleged elements / cited paragraph / record support / response question table. Flag deadlines as unverified until service and any orders are checked.

Title: Discovery response workplan
Summary: Assign answers, objections, and collection tasks.
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [discovery requests], [service details], [case management order], [custodian list], [known repositories].
TASK: Classify each request by topic, likely custodian, collection source, privilege concern, proposed objection question, and needed client input. Verify current Florida procedural deadlines and any case-specific order.
OUTPUT: Request-by-request workplan and missing-data questions. Do not invent documents or waive objections by assuming facts.

Title: Motion response authority plan
Summary: Find controlling sources before drafting an opposition.
RolePerspective: Florida litigation research attorney preparing an opposition outline
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [opposing motion], [record excerpts], [court], [hearing date], [client objective].
TASK: Extract the motion's propositions and identify which require authority, factual rebuttal, or both. Research current primary Florida authority if available, checking procedural rules, appellate district, treatment, and case posture.
OUTPUT: Proposition / supporting citation claimed / verified authority / record response / research gap matrix, followed by an opposition outline. Never fabricate a case or quote.

Title: Deposition preparation outline
Summary: Build topic blocks tied to evidence and exhibits.
RolePerspective: Florida litigation counsel preparing a witness examination
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [pleadings], [witness role], [chronology], [production], [key exhibits].
TASK: Identify admissions to seek, disputed events, exhibit foundations, and follow-up paths. Separate known testimony from questions to test.
OUTPUT: Ordered topic blocks with objective, exhibit reference, primary question, follow-up, and impeachment source. Include a list of factual gaps for attorney preparation.

Title: Mediation exposure brief
Summary: Summarize litigation positions and settlement levers.
RolePerspective: Florida trial counsel preparing confidential mediation advice
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [pleadings], [evidence summary], [damages model], [offers], [client objectives].
TASK: Present the strongest and weakest documented points for each side. Build best, central, and adverse scenarios with stated assumptions, without inventing probabilities or recoveries.
OUTPUT: One-page confidential preparation brief, scenario table, nonmonetary terms to consider, and decisions requiring client authority.

Title: Client intake questions
Summary: Turn a real estate problem into a focused fact interview.
RolePerspective: Florida real-estate attorney preparing an intake interview
PromptBody:
CONTEXT: [short client description], [property type], [desired outcome], [known dates].
TASK: Generate a concise first-call question sequence for a Florida real estate matter. Ask threshold questions first, then documents, timeline, counterparties, financial exposure, and urgency.
OUTPUT: No more than 15 grouped questions, each marked essential or follow-up, plus a requested-document list. Avoid assuming the client has a viable claim.

Title: Client update email
Summary: Convert a verified matter record into a clear update.
RolePerspective: Client-service attorney drafting a plain-language matter update
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [verified status notes], [completed work], [open decisions], [dates], [client audience].
TASK: Draft a concise Florida matter update in plain language. Put the decision requested from the client near the top; distinguish completed work, next steps, and contingent dates.
OUTPUT: Subject line and email of about 200–300 words. Do not add assurances or legal conclusions absent from the verified notes; leave placeholders for missing information.

Title: Redline instruction set
Summary: Produce precise proposed clause edits for counsel.
RolePerspective: Florida transactional real-estate attorney revising a negotiated clause
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [existing provision], [document definitions], [negotiation goal], [nonnegotiable terms], [which party represented].
TASK: Identify ambiguity and unintended consequences, then provide a revised provision that fits the document's style and defined terms. Do not silently change unrelated economics.
OUTPUT: Issue list, clean replacement clause, change log keyed to the original language, and two remaining negotiation choices.

Title: Federal tax research plan for a property sale
Summary: Create an authority-driven research map, not a tax conclusion.
RolePerspective: Federal tax attorney preparing an issue list for tax-adviser review
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [seller type], [property use], [acquisition and improvement records], [sale terms], [tax year].
TASK: Identify federal income tax issues that counsel or a tax adviser should research, including amount realized, basis, depreciation, character, and reporting where relevant. Check current Internal Revenue Code, regulations, and IRS guidance if sources are available.
OUTPUT: Issue / missing fact / primary authority to verify / possible treatment stated conditionally / adviser question table. Do not compute liability without complete figures.

Title: Section 1031 exchange intake
Summary: Surface qualification questions and critical timing facts.
RolePerspective: Federal tax counsel coordinating a possible Section 1031 exchange
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [relinquished and replacement property facts], [owners], [closing timeline], [intermediary information], [proceeds flow].
TASK: Build a federal Section 1031 exchange intake roadmap. Verify current statutory and regulatory requirements, including eligibility, identification, timing, related parties, and intermediary issues before stating a rule.
OUTPUT: Eligibility decision tree, dated milestone worksheet with assumptions, document requests, and questions for the exchange intermediary and tax adviser. Avoid promising deferral.

Title: Federal wage and hour audit questions
Summary: Organize FLSA classification and pay evidence.
RolePerspective: Federal employment counsel reviewing wage and hour practices
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [job descriptions], [pay practices], [time records], [work location], [review period].
TASK: Identify federal FLSA wage and hour questions on coverage, exempt classification, hours worked, overtime, recordkeeping, and possible limitations. Verify current federal rules and note any Florida overlay separately.
OUTPUT: Employee group / known practice / required evidence / federal authority to check / risk question table. Do not decide exemption status without duties and pay facts.

Title: Accommodation request response map
Summary: Structure an ADA interactive-process review.
RolePerspective: Federal employment counsel preparing an accommodation process review
PromptBody:
INPUTS: [employee request], [job duties], [communications], [dates], [available alternatives].
TASK: Build a neutral chronology and issue map for a federal employment accommodation request. Identify information needed to evaluate essential functions, possible accommodations, and undue hardship under current applicable federal law, without assuming a medical conclusion.
OUTPUT: Dated events, information request list, options to discuss, decision factors with sources to verify, and a draft acknowledgement for counsel review.
